The '''Federation of Vinterholm''' is a federal state and original member of the [[Northern Alliance]].

== Alliance Role ==

Vinterholm's early alliance ties with the [[Theorin Commonwealth]] helped create the broader Northern Alliance in 1839. Its role in the alliance centered on military cooperation, technology sharing, commerce, and collective security.

During the [[Bakorian War]], Vinterholm was one of the Northern Alliance members that provided covert support to the [[Bakorian Republic]]. The support did not prevent Bakoria's defeat, but it tied Vinterholm to the regional modernization debate that followed.

== Source Notes ==

The extracted Vinterholm page is mostly an infobox. It identifies the state as a federation with Gross Ilmsdorf as capital and [[Rontzken]] as an official language. This bridge page preserves only the facts needed for the 1994-back northern war cluster.
